mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that triggers central bank policy accommodation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months signals a broad-based economic slowdown, prompting central bank intervention and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST decline for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0% for three consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.0% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong aggregate demand, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90.0 for two consecutive months, it indicates a manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to recessionary fears.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 90.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) for two consecutive months signals aggressive monetary tightening amid a tight labor market, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with monetary tightening
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion (defined by rising housing starts and strong consumer spending), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to improving economic fundamentals and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when housing starts and consumer spending are rising, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
